items.label: STOCK vs. FLOW
items.text: LAB-ROOT-0007 (ARCA, Cuadro 1) is monthly stock data only; LAB-B1 already declared registration-flow (altas/bajas) data SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE in every ARCA publication evaluated, and the pre-registered METRIC needs a transition/flow rate.

items.label: EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP coverage gap
items.text: the only source this project has operationalized for LAB-OBJ-0003 is MLER (LAB-ROOT-0003), whose admitted period ends 2021-12, four years before the selected episode.

witness.segment_text: The only source this project has operationalized for EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP (LAB-OBJ-0003) is MLER (LAB-ROOT-0003), whose admitted period ends 2021-12 -- before even the earliest realistically-datable episode this project could construct, and four years before the LAB-B4-selected episode (2025-08-01).

items.label: No person-level linkage
items.text: no source admitted anywhere in this project (ARCA, SIPA, MLER, EPH) shares a person-level identifier with any other (LAB-CLM-0003 already established this absence between EPH and SIPA/MLER; LAB-B1/LAB-B4 found no different situation for ARCA), so even a perfectly-windowed episode with every source admitted could not measure an individual-level transition rate as pre-registered.
